messages:
anya: quick postmortem from today's speculative+quant pilot on raven-13b-quant
mike: thanks — quick tl;dr?
anya: short: ~2.3x token/sec improvement at p95 latency for short chats, but found a consistent quality dip on summarization & code-completion suites (~3-6% rouge / pass@1 deltas). Repro steps attached below.
oliver: can you paste the exact config you used? batch sizes + prefetch window?
anya: sure
anya: ```
model: raven-13b-quant
decode: speculative
speculative_params:
  speculative_ratio: 1.4
  early_accept_threshold: 0.92
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
  prefer_latency_over_throughput: false
kv_prefetch: true
quant: int4-dynamic
tracing: enabled
``` 
sophia: do we have a concrete sample where it regressed? a small prompt to reproduce?
anya: yes — summarization micro-suite (news-50) and a few code prompts from codegen-10k. Example (news):
anya: "Summarize: The committee voted 7-2 to approve..." expected short factual bullet list. raven-quant produced hallucinated bullet about a committee member that didn't exist.
mike: ugh. can you share scores? even rough numbers?
anya: pasted from CI run (all runs on dedicated pool `d-prod-pilot`):
anya: ```
throughput: baseline-speculative (float16) = 280 tok/s
throughput: quant-speculative (int4) = 640 tok/s
p95 latency: baseline = 210ms, quant = 92ms
rouge-l (news-50): baseline = 0.412, quant = 0.388
code pass@1 (codegen-10k): baseline = 0.71, quant = 0.67
```
liam: baseline here is our float16 speculative setup? good improvement on perf but the Q drop is non-trivial.
ci-bot: automated-eval: run_id=2026-03-20T15:12Z, seed=42, workers=12
ci-bot: attached logs: /artifacts/runs/5332109876/summary.html
oliver: did we try disabling early_accept (i.e., lower speculative_ratio) or forcing speculation only on top-k tokens?
anya: quick A/B we did three variants this morning:
anya: - int4 + full speculative (above config)  => best perf, worst quality
anya: - int4 + conservative spec (ratio=1.1, threshold=0.98) => perf ~1.6x, quality gap reduced to ~1.5% on rouge
anya: - int4 + speculative-disabled (standard sampling) => perf ~1.2x, quality nearly baseline
sophia: that smells like quantized logits + aggressive early accept is amplifying small probability shifts into wrong accepts.
mike: agree. maybe the calibration on int4 logits is off — quantization bias towards high-confidence peaks
liam: thought: add a light post-calibration step on logits before speculative accept. e.g., temperature scaling or additive bias correction from a tiny calibration set.
oliver: also check KV cache fidelity — int4 might be causing drift in cache reuse for multi-turn prompts.
anya: we inspected KV diffs for a few cases, there are small deltas but not enough alone to explain hallucinations. combined with early_accept seems plausible.
sophia: propose next actions:
- run targeted calibration sweep: temp-scaling in [0.9,1.0,1.1], additive bias in [-0.02..0.02]
- run conservative spec on full news-50 & codegen-10k
- add golden-run diff logging for hallucinated summaries (automate grep)
- compare token-level acceptance mismatches (where speculative path accepted different token than baseline)
mike: timeline? if we want to keep pilot in prod flow we should decide by EOD.
anya: I can kick off sweeps now on a small dedicated shard. will send updated perf+quality matrix in ~3h.
liam: add an eval hook that computes "speculative_accept_delta" per example.
oliver: also capture the raw logits for the first 8 tokens after prompt, that helps debugging acceptance boundary.
ci-bot: scheduled job: 2026-03-20T16:05Z run=5332109876-sweep-1
anya: also FYI — quant-only (no spec) seems safe to ship for internal low-latency tiers; the regressions are mostly when both features are on.
sophia: good note — we can gate speculative for quant models until after calibration.
mike: agree. for public pilot: rollback speculative flag for raven-13b-quant and keep quant rollout. small perf loss but better safety.
anya: rolling back speculative for raven-13b-quant on d-prod-pilot now.
ci-bot: deploy: user=anya, action=rollback, target=raven-13b-quant, flag=speculative, status=started
ci-bot: deploy: status=success, 2026-03-20T15:44Z
anya: thanks everyone — will post sweep results when available. key learning: speculation interacts non-linearly with quantized logits; calibration + conservative early-accept looks promising.
mike: great work. prioritize calibration + add the accept-delta metric to release gating.
liam: and add a short doc in eng-ml/ops about speculative+quant pitfalls.
anya: will draft quick note in /wiki and ping here when done :thumbsup:
